headline: New South Wales Labor Pledges A$6.8 Billion South Coast Rail Electrification
summary: The NSW government promised A$6.8 billion to electrify the rail line between Kiama and Bomaderry and add extra tracks, reversing previously planned South Coast rail timetable cutbacks.
why: Public infrastructure investments stimulate regional construction activity and improve transit capacity, directly impacting engineering contractors and state budget balances.

impacts.name: Infrastructure
impacts.why: A$6.8 billion in rail electrification and track construction contracts creates multi-year revenue opportunities for civil engineering firms.
